exposure: Pregnancies complicated by epilepsy vs normal pregnancies
poor seizure control one year prior to the pregnancy
cohort: 124 pregnant women with epilepsy compared with 277 healthy pregnant women
finding: Epileptic seizures in pregnancy are associated with increased risks of adverse delivery and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with epilepsy were at increased risk of cesarean section compared with pregnancies of women without epilepsy (p < 0.0001).
